summary: Innovation Beverage Group Ltd, an Australian foreign private issuer listed on Nasdaq, furnished a Form 6-K disclosing a notice of an Extraordinary General Meeting scheduled for October 9, 2026 in Sydney. Shareholders will vote on a reverse stock split (share consolidation) at a ratio to be set by the Board, capped at 10:1, with fractional shares rounded up. If approved, the Company intends to implement the consolidation within 120 days and will notify Nasdaq of the effective date. No price, premium, advisor, or deal terms are stated; this is a routine meeting notice, not a special situation.
